review.summary: Diff vs base 7c13918 changes only code.mjs (a-b -> a+b) and code.test.mjs (+33 regression lines). add(a,b) returns a+b and is correct for positive, negative, zero and fractional inputs. node --test code.test.mjs: 5/5 pass, exit 0. Revert-proof verified in a scratch copy: 0/5 pass with a-b. All four acceptance categories covered; isolated artifact, no doc/changelog/verify obligations. No defects found.

add(a,b) fixed from a-b to a+b, computing correct numeric addition for positive, negative, zero and fractional inputs. Tests extended with positive, negative, zero (including the human-requested add(-4.5,0)===-4.5 at line 18 and its mirror), and fractional assertions. Verified at the tip: node code.test.mjs exit 0, node --test code.test.mjs 1/1 pass; the suite fails against the pre-existing a-b implementation (code.test.mjs:1, -1 !== 5), so the regression coverage genuinely discriminates. Diff limited to code.mjs and code.test.mjs; no secrets, no unrelated files. Note, not a defect: an unscoped node --test at the repo root collects the whole repository (2066 tests, 411 fails) and returns exit 0, so it proves nothing for this artifact; only the scoped run is meaningful.
